lines: (The worm tips his top hat.) Good day! Sir Squiggle, at your service.
The flowers blink in time again. Splendid!
Do excuse me. I simply MUST dance about it.
(The worm tips his top hat.) Good day! Sir Squiggle, at your service.
Everything here's growing backwards. My hat keeps getting newer!
Bramble says you can help. Jolly good!

rotate: Wiggle to the left, wiggle to the right!
Ah, I do love a forward-going day.
A gentleman always tips his hat.
And a worm always wiggles. I'm both!
The moss is soft again. Perfect for a twirl!
Wake the Sun Blooms, there's a good chap.
I tried to dance, but my steps went backwards.
Rather fun, actually. Don't tell Bramble.
One must look smart, even when time's gone silly.
